Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects toolpaths, full-tool collision checks, and NC posting.

What looks good:
- The generator and the independent verifier check protected faces and edges.
- The command validates the selection and supports undo. The MCP tools use the command.
- Empty protection preserves the plain paths in the motion test.
- The project format rejects readers that cannot preserve the protection.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`, as current upstream rules require.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41` failed in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:283`. The conflict combines cutting-data text from #2077 with the Weldon holder text on main. I aborted the merge. All results below apply to the unchanged PR head, not to a merged tree. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test --no-run` for the three new safety suites: passed.
- `camcraft-sim` / `verify_avoid`: 2 passed.
- `camcraft-motion` / `avoid_pocket`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-app` / `do_not_touch`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 850 passed; 6 ignored.
- App regression suites: `area_controls` 13, `area_open` 11, `cutting_unknown_row` 9, `fixture_route` 7, `pocket_overhead` 2, `project_roundtrip` 73, and `tool_cutting_rows` 11 passed.
- Tools regression suites: `unknown_row` 6 and `waterjet` 6 passed.
- Clippy on all targets of tools, sim, motion, app, and ui, with `-D warnings`: passed.
- The quick gate plan was read with `--dry-run`. The full quick and release gates were not run by this review.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:
1. Make `avoid_hits` return an empty warning list. Both `verify_avoid` tests failed. The first failure reported `zero-distance touch must block: []`. After restoration, both tests passed.
2. Make `Warning::AvoidHit` non-blocking in `blocks_post`. The app post-gate test failed with `cached AvoidHit must block post: Posted`. After restoration, the test passed.

Both mutations were removed. The source diff is empty. The PR changes no NC or CL golden files and no snapshot PNGs.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs:305` and the PR body: Add before/after screenshots for the changed UI. Include the protected-item rows, clearance control, and viewport marks. The current body has no screenshot links. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

Notes:
- The PR remains a draft and has a code conflict. Keep the `conflicts` label. Follow the merge-time refresh rule after the parent is selected for merge.
- The head commit has no `Fixes #2055` footer, although the PR body has it. Include the required footer in the next commit without rewriting published history.
- The body identifies the missing tilted 3+2 app test. This review did not add that coverage or run the GUI.
- `generate.rs` and `boundary.rs` already exceed the source-size guideline and grow in this PR. Split these modules in later work.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:
- Added before/after UI screenshots and linked them from the PR body. The after image shows protected face and edge-chain rows, Clearance 1.25 mm, and viewport marks. Images live only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The body explains the parent-source before capture.
- Extended `geometry_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_rows_and_viewport_marks` to check both protected descriptions below Clearance in selection order. Hiding the descriptions makes this pin RED. Restoring them makes it GREEN.
- Added the required `Fixes #2055` footer to both new commits.
- Merged `upstream/main`. Kept the cutting-data description and Weldon holder description. Main's process and release files are unchanged relative to main. Review labels remain unchanged.

Quick gate: GREEN (5 steps, 0 failed). Clippy on tools, sim, motion, app, and ui, all targets with `-D warnings`: GREEN.

New head: `928c878dbcdae917f1de9523213caeb1874b451d`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

**Verdict: clean.** This is the second, independent safety-floor review of this head. Built locally in a worktree off `origin/main` (`aaddb2d48`); the trial merge with `main` was clean. Head checked: `928c878dbcdae917f1de9523213caeb1874b451d`.

## What I ran
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test verify_avoid`: 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test do_not_touch`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib do_not_touch`: 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Safety-floor checks (verified in code)
1. A gouge against a protected face blocks the post. Three layers prove it: generation adds `Warning::AvoidHit`, which `blocks_post()` returns true for; `live_avoid_problems` re-checks every cached path against the steel as it stands now; and the post gate returns `post blocked - ...` before NC output. The app test asserts the NC file never exists after a blocked post.
2. The breaking change is documented. The commit uses `feat(boundaries)!:`. `PROJECT_VERSION` steps `63 -> 64` with the reason stated, and the load test proves a newer file is refused with `UnsupportedVersion` rather than ignored.
3. Degenerate input gives a clean error. Commands, project validation, and `collect_items` refuse vertices, non-finite geometry, empty facet sets, chains under two points, bad clearance, and overlap with the machining selection. No panic on these paths. The one `unreachable!()` arm in `collect_items` is guarded by an early vertex check in the same loop.
4. Legacy behaviour is preserved. The `has_boundary_edits()` split keeps empty protection byte-identical; the motion test `empty_avoid_matches_plain_paths_exactly` pins it for all four entry points.
5. Laws: no new crate dependency (no `Cargo.toml` change; `motion` already depends on `sim`). No edit to `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`; the body states `Process change: yes`. `docs/decisions/2055-do-not-touch.md` is complete. The new command ships with its MCP tools and the skill row. Undo inverts the stamp with it. All new files are under 400 lines.

## Findings (not blocking)
1. A cut level fully blocked by protection adds a note and continues; the program finishes with that level uncut. Nothing touches the protected item, and the simulation shows the left material. The all-blocked case refuses by name. If the maintainer wants an "incomplete" op state for partial programs, file a follow-up issue.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs` ends with two `let _ =` stubs that silence unused-import warnings. Remove the imports instead.
3. `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs` is now 437 lines (411 before this change). It was already over the 400-line rule.
4. Stack order: this branch carries the commits of #2077, whose base is `main` and which is still open. Merge #2077 first, as the body says; a merge of this PR alone would land that code out of order.

This PR does not merge with `main` now. The merge batch did not refresh it.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects protected geometry, collision checks, toolpaths, and NC posting.

What looks good:
- The commands validate protected selections and support undo. The MCP tools use these commands.
- The format barrier is now v68. The test checks persistence and refusal of future versions.
- The earlier screenshot request is complete. Both links open. The after image shows the rows, clearance, and viewport marks.
- The unused imports and stubs are removed. The body has `Process change: yes`. This PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No NC, CL, or PNG golden files changed. There are no moved goldens to check.

Local verification:

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2149`. No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge with upstream main `f887908f9901393d9aeb1356d5f8208e01bf0fbd` was clean.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Failed: E0599, described below |
| Sim `verify_avoid` | 2 passed |
| Motion `avoid_pocket` | 3 passed |
| App `do_not_touch`, `stock_deburr_part`, `wcs_flip` | 3, 5, and 10 passed |
| App `area_controls`, `area_open`, `carried_stock_entry`, `clearance_in_stock`, `fixture_route`, `pocket_overhead`, `project_roundtrip` | 119 passed |
| Motion `level_links`, `machining2d`, `machining3d`, `offset_shells`, `rest2d`, `rest_adaptive` | 131 passed; 1 ignored |
| Sim `arc_plane`, `arc_sweep`, `fixture_stack_span`, `midturn_swept_band`, `posed_rapids`, `vertical_rapids` | 39 passed |
| UI full lib, from `crates/ui` | 1,017 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |

| Strict all-target clippy on tools, sim, motion, app, and ui | Failed: the same E0599 |
| Quick gate `--dry-run` | Plan read; the full gate was not run |

The UI failure was `setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`. It reported `Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4)` from a scroll-area repaint. Its immediate isolated rerun passed. I do not attribute this timing failure to the PR.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body myself:
1. Make `avoid_hits` return no warnings. Both `verify_avoid` tests failed. Restore it: both tests passed.
2. Make `Warning::AvoidHit` non-blocking. The app test failed with `cached AvoidHit must block post: Posted`. Restore it: the test passed.

Both mutations are removed. The temporary reproduction test is removed. The merged worktree has no unstaged source changes. No review evidence was committed.

Requested before merge:

1. **Sweep the space between samples on vertical arcs.** `crates/sim/src/verify/avoid.rs:158` calls `solid::pieces`. For XZ and YZ arcs, that helper returns stationary samples every 0.5 mm, with no sweep or growth between them. I reproduced a missed protected-edge contact on the unchanged implementation. An XZ arc runs from `(-10, 0, 10)` to `(0, 0, 0)`, with center `(0, 10)` and `ccw=false`. A flat cutter has radius 3 mm. Its flute, shank, and holder each have length 10 mm and radius 3 mm. Clearance is zero. The protected edge runs from `(-0.24541228522912326, 2.999, 0.5030118130379577)` to `(-0.24541228522912326, 3.009, 0.5030118130379577)`. At arc fraction `0.984375`, a stationary check reports `AvoidHit`, with flute penetration `0.0009999999999998899` mm. Checking the complete arc returns `[]`. The independent test therefore fails. `live_avoid_problems` uses this verifier too. Sweep conservative chords with a bound on their deviation, or use an equivalent continuous check. Add a test that detects contact between samples. More point samples alone do not prove clearance.

2. **Restore the constructor call on current main.** `crates/motion/src/machining3d/shell.rs:107` replaces `Field::new` with `Field::new_with_avoid`. Main's `crossing_hop_tests.rs:46` still calls `Field::new(&[])`. The clean trial merge therefore cannot build the motion lib tests. Update the caller or preserve a suitable constructor. Run the merged build and clippy again. Both currently report:

   ```text
   error[E0599]: no associated function or constant named `new` found for struct `shell::Field`
     --> crates/motion/src/machining3d/crossing_hop_tests.rs:46:24
   ```

3. **Cache the protection overlay geometry.** `crates/ui/src/avoid_viz.rs:27` resolves features, rebuilds patches, and projects every protected facet on each call. `egui_app/shell.rs:615` calls it on every viewport frame. A still frame repeats this work for the full protected selection. Current upstream `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, under `Frame cost`, requires reuse until the inputs change. Add a cache with keys for the relevant inputs. Add still-frame and changed-input counter tests. Measure this new frame piece with `frame_cost::span` or `frame_cost::time`.

Notes:
- Main moved during the review. A later merge simulation against `feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5` reports a conflict in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs`. GitHub also reports `CONFLICTING`. The test results above apply to the earlier recorded main SHA. Keep `conflicts` beside `needs-rework`. Refresh the branch under the merge-time rule.
- The body still describes v64 and older validation heads. Update that text to describe the final format and validation results.
- The full quick gate, release gate, and GUI were not run in this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The required conflict refresh reached the stop condition before fixes or verification.

The latest review requests three changes:
- Sweep between samples on vertical arcs. Add a contact test.
- Restore the constructor call used by the motion tests on main.
- Cache the protection overlay. Add counter tests and frame timing.

The review also requests current format and validation text in the PR body.

I tried to merge upstream/main at feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5. Both sides change the same logic in crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs:
- run_plain_with, head lines 102-103: the PR uses cut_levels and passes avoid to ladder. Main uses cut_levels_under with p.links.approach.stock_top.
- run_rest_with, head lines 287-288: the PR uses cut_levels and passes avoid to the coarse ladder. Main uses cut_levels_under with p.links.approach.stock_top.

The author-side instructions require a stop when both sides change the same logic. I aborted the merge. The worktree is clean. No changes were committed or pushed. No tests, mutations, gate, or clippy ran.

The PR head remains 1c0bf5e69ab855133571a52a1596fca602414472. Labels and draft state are unchanged. No review evidence was committed.

Please review these conflict hunks before another fix attempt. Re-review of the requested fixes must wait until they are implemented and verified.
